verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing docs note that 'ChatGPT data controls' apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including Computer Use screenshots. That implies user-facing data controls exist but never says they include an opt-out from model training. The /memories controls govern personalization, not training, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a model-training opt-out setting, how to enable it, which plans or surfaces it covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
